description: Semantic classification of names defined by at least one fixed-width backend but missing from at least one of SVE or RVV. Each scalable backend is audited separately so their union cannot hide an asymmetric hole. This is not a user-capability count: vec.h generic definitions and implementation selectors are classified separately.

shared_generic.rationale: Already implemented once in vec.h and intended to instantiate for SVE/RVV. Requires compile-instantiation coverage, not another backend-local definition.

selector.rationale: Native/emulated implementation selector behind an umbrella operation. It is not an independent public semantic capability.

fixed_model.rationale: Expresses a fixed register half or 128-bit block construction. Add a scalable implementation only when a product kernel needs the precise block contract; otherwise document a scalable-native equivalent or N/A.

extension_gated.rationale: The semantic is useful, but an efficient implementation depends on an optional ISA facility or memory-ordering contract. Provide a separately compiled feature variant or an explicit fallback, never assume the extension from base SVE/RVV.

portable_missing.rationale: Portable semantic capability with no scalable backend-local definition and no shared generic definition detected by the mechanical audit. These are the primary register-layer implementation backlog.
